title: EP&P CSAT Survey
introText: As an important internal client of EP&P in GCH, your input is critical to help us improve our services and measure our impact to you.
instructionText: Please take two minutes to complete this survey and share your feedback.
serviceLinePrompt: Please mark below the Service Line(s) you have used and help us answer the related questions

serviceLines.label: Supplier Onboarding
serviceLines.description: Facilitates supplier setup, documentation, and system enablement to ensure suppliers are ready for seamless engagement.

questions.text: How clear were the onboarding process and guidelines/training provided?
How effectively did the Onboarding team support you throughout the process?
Was the turn-around time aligned with your expectations?
What went well and what could be improved?

serviceLines.label: Service Desk
serviceLines.description: Acts as the first point of contact for procurement-related queries, issue resolution, and general support to ensure smooth operations.

questions.text: How effective was the Service Desk team in addressing your queries?
How responsive was the Service Desk team to your queries?
What went well and what could be improved?

serviceLines.label: Accounts Payable
serviceLines.description: Handles invoice processing, payments, and query resolution to ensure timely and accurate supplier payments.

questions.text: How easy was it to review and/or approve the invoices?
How clear was the process to check the status of your invoice?
Were the invoices you submitted and/or approved processed on time?
What went well and what could be improved?

serviceLines.label: Buy Desk
serviceLines.description: Sourcing support for purchases below USD 100k. Provides purchase order support, requisition processing, and transactional buying assistance to enable efficient procurement execution.

questions.text: How easy was it to submit a Sourcing Support Request Form (SSRF)?
How helpful was the Buy Desk in supporting your request?
If you submitted a SSRF before agreeing the commercials with the supplier, was the Buy Desk able to negotiate a better deal?
What went well and what could be improved?

serviceLines.label: Sourcing
serviceLines.description: Sourcing support for purchases above USD 100k. Supports supplier selection, contract negotiations, renewals, and competitive bidding to help you achieve optimal value.

questions.text: How well did the Sourcing team understand your business needs?
How effective was the collaboration and communication with the team?
If you submitted a SSRF before agreeing the commercials with the supplier, was the Sourcing team able to negotiate a better deal?
What went well and what could be improved?

serviceLines.label: Risk Screening
serviceLines.description: Supports risk screening requests as part of the sourcing and supplier management process.

questions.text: How easy was it to submit a Risk Screening request?
Were your requests handled in a timely manner?
What went well and what could be improved?

recognitionQuestion: Would you like to highlight any EP&P members who have gone above and beyond in providing you with exceptional service?
